magic3d.subtitle: Transcending the traditional web. We engineer immersive digital experiences where cinema cameras deconstruct in 3D, luxury goods float with fluid particles, and social media reels break through phone screens.
magic3d.cameraDesc: We showcase the internal anatomy of every shoot: full-frame CMOS sensors, anamorphic lens elements, and 8K processing chips floating in precision 3D space. Technical storytelling that conveys unshakable authority.
magic3d.camBullet1: Isolated 6K/8K CMOS Sensor with realistic glass reflections
magic3d.camBullet2: Multi-layer spherical and anamorphic glass elements
magic3d.productDesc: We build commercials and landing pages where the product is the hero: luxury perfume bottles floating weightlessly, rose petals falling with fluid physics, and volumetric studio lighting. Perfect for cosmetics, perfumery, and premium goods.
magic3d.prodBullet1: Dynamic petals and fluid particles falling in 3D space
magic3d.prodBullet2: Real glass refractions, translucent liquids and gold caustics
magic3d.prodBullet3: Proven surge in conversion rates and perceived brand value
magic3d.mobileDesc: On social media, you have 2 seconds to stop the scroll. We craft video creatives where your product and graphics physically break through the mobile viewport, generating 3D optical illusions that drive viral retention.
magic3d.mobBullet1: Cameras and products jumping out of the smartphone UI
magic3d.mobBullet2: Analog film ribbons and sparks orbiting in 3D perspective
magic3d.mobBullet3: Surgically scripted for high completion rates on Reels & TikTok
